description: This file manages provider catalog entries, modules, and export maps for bundled plugins, including functions to resolve entries, load modules, and handle export mappings with caching and error checking.

methods.name: resolveBundledProviderCatalogEntries
methods.description: Resolves and returns an array of bundled provider catalog entries, optionally based on a specified root directory, with caching for default root.

methods.name: loadBundledProviderCatalogModules
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns a record of provider catalog modules, importing them dynamically based on catalog entries, with caching for default root.

methods.name: loadBundledProviderCatalogExportMap
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns a map of export names to export values from provider catalog modules, ensuring no duplicate exports across modules.
